comparison.objective: Test spring-hinge deployment in a gravity-neutral orientation by removing a hold-down pin.
comparison.physical_skill: Orient the assembly and extract a pin, then observe passive spring deployment and latching.
comparison.success_condition: Spring alone opens the panel to its latch after pin removal. Clearance, deployment-rate, latch, and spec-version details are absent.
comparison.reason: Both observe dynamic mechanical response, but this is a release-and-observe test without iterative adjustment.
